messages:
sofia: kicking off preflight for tenant_shard migration - target window 02:00-03:00 UTC. I'm going to run the lockwatch check before we open the slot.

deploy-bot: scheduled window reserved by @maria, canary group pinned to v2.3.1, deploy id: db-mig-1795. Will post holdpoints.

liam: thanks. quick heads-up: we saw higher-than-usual row-level contention on shard-7 during yesterday's backfill. I ran a trace; locks spiked when the reindex job overlapped with a user-report job.

sofia: yep saw that in the metrics. plan is: small canary (10 tenants), prefix KV cache warm, run read-only verification, then schema apply with constrained concurrency.

maria: @sofia also add a pinned runtime version for the canary VMs (runtime 1.14.0) so we don't get unexpected kernel changes mid-run.

sofia: done. pinned runtime and added canary label. deploy-bot: please gate on lockwatch < 5 active row locks in last 5m on target shard.

deploy-bot: holdpoint created: "preflight-lockwatch". Condition: lockwatch_active_rowlocks <= 5 for 5m. Will auto-advance if met, otherwise will keep on hold.

avril: if lockwatch doesn't clear by 02:15 UTC, escalate to manual review. Also set rollback trigger: if schema apply pauses > 120s waiting on row locks, abort.

paul: logging: added a deploy-slowhook to surface any apply waits over 60s to #eng-oncall.

sofia: SQL snippet for the apply (safe alter):
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE tenant_shard ADD COLUMN new_flag boolean DEFAULT false;
-- ensure no INDEX BUILD here that holds long locks
COMMIT;
```

liam: looks good. for backfill we'll use batched updates:
```
UPDATE tenant_shard SET new_flag = true WHERE id BETWEEN ? AND ? LIMIT 1000;
```
Running with 10s throttle between batches.

maria: release notes: call out the canary + pin + rollback criteria. I'll draft and attach to the deploy ticket.

sofia: small canary started at 02:01 UTC. deploy-bot: report status.

deploy-bot: canary step: apply-started on 2 nodes. lockwatch counts: shard-7: 2 active locks; shard-3: 0. KV cache warm: 92%.

liam: monitoring DB tail - seeing one spike at 02:04 for 30s but it cleared.

sofia: holding for 5m to verify no recurring spikes.

ops-bot: alert: recurring_lock_surge detected on shard-7 at 02:09 (3 spikes in last 6m). Increasing hold.

maria: pivot: cancel remaining canaries, rollback apply on canary nodes, and mark slot for post-mortem. We will re-evaluate throttles and split tenants smaller.

sofia: ack. running rollback command now. deploy-bot: execute rollback db-mig-1795 on canary nodes.

deploy-bot: rollback executed: canary nodes reverted to pre-apply schema. All canary instances healthy. Marked window as aborted for manual rerun.

sofia: post-mortem notes for follow-up: tighten backfill batch size to 250 rows, add dynamic backoff when row locks > 3, and consider adding an intermediate read-only verification step between canary and full rollout.

maria: thanks team. I'll update the release notes + notify product. Re-scheduling next window for 3/5 02:00 UTC with new throttles.

paul: adding runbook entry: if ops-bot detects recurring_lock_surge during canary, auto-cancel and rollback.

sofia: thanks all. closing this thread."
